Tropical rainforests, on the other hand, are characterized by hot and humid climates filled with a variety of plants, animals, fish, reptiles, and invertebrates. Rainforests are some of the most diverse ecosystems in the world, but are also some of the most fragile, as deforestation or even changes in temperature due to climate change can cause wide-scale destruction. prompt: What are the three levels of disruption according to Christensen's theory?\n\n

The first level of disruption is low-end disruption, where a firm enters the market serving the needs of customers whose needs are not being met by existing technology. 

The second level of disruption is new-market disruption, where a firm offers a product that consumes a new market that was previously nonexistent. 

The third level of disruption is called sustained disruption, which is when an established firm successfully disrupts itself by maintaining the same set of users while introducing the latest technologies.

In addition, a presence online also allows individuals to stay informed on news and events, which can help foster feelings of belonging and connectivity. 

Conclusion
Social media can have both positive and negative impacts on mental health. It is important for people to be aware of the potential risks of being active on social media and to be mindful of the amount of time and energy that can be spent on the platforms. It is also important to be mindful of how our online presence can shape our perceptions, both of ourselves and of the world.
